purpose: per-group per-gene mean expression and fraction expressing, for the atlas marker panels — the only part of a dotplot that needs the .h5ad. All rendering (light/dark, layout, ordering) happens downstream from this CSV with no further cluster access.
CAVEAT: panel_quality is load-bearing: Stro-9 and Stro-10 have NO gene clearing a specificity margin at any threshold, so their panels are flagged best_available and any figure using them must state that the genes are not subtype-specific.
